## Where docs live

- **README.md**: overview, installation, development (pre-commit, semgrep). It links to the external docs on **DeepWiki** (`deepwiki.com/Tacten/biograph`) and the Telegram group.
- **`wiki/`** holds in-repo feature docs as UPPER-KEBAB markdown:
  - **design docs** (`DESIGN-BLOCKBASED-THERAPY-APPOINTMENT-BOOKING.md`, `FHIR Terminology Service Parity — Implementation Plan.md`, `insurance-parity-report.md`)
  - **usage docs** (`BLOCK-APPOINTMENT-BOOKING-USAGE.md`, `PATIENT-DUPLICATE-CHECKER-USAGE-DOC.md`) with a table of contents, numbered sections, examples and screenshots or demo links stored alongside (`patient-duplicatecheck-thumbnail.png`)
- `AGENTS.md` is a Build-managed index of `.build/guides/`. Do not edit the managed block.

## Docs gate in CI

`.github/workflows/docs_checker.yml` runs `.github/helper/documentation.py`. Any PR whose title starts with `feat` must include a docs link (a `biograph.frappe.cloud` or `biograph.io` URL with `/wiki` in the path) in its body, unless the body contains `no-docs` or `backport`.

## Practice

New user-facing features get a usage doc in `wiki/`, and a design doc for larger work, plus a docs link in the PR.
